messages:
olivia: Heads-up: ACME tenant on dedicated-prod-pool is seeing 429s and token-throttles since ~03:00 UTC. Customer reports tail latency spikes on long-context calls (multi-turn, ~50k-70k tokens). Logs show rapid kv_cache eviction bursts and 'memfrag reclaim' warnings.
raj: Can you paste a sample request id + model/version and a snippet of the eviction log?
olivia: sample req ids: req-AB12, req-AB15. Model: rwkv-13b-ctx64k@v2. Eviction snippets pasted below: 
```
[03:04:12] runtime.kv_cache: evict tenant=acme freed=124MB reason=frag_score>0.8
[03:04:12] runtime.kv_cache: evict tenant=acme freed=1.2GB entries=2400
[03:04:13] rpc: respond 429 tenant=acme route=/v1/generate
[03:04:15] runtime: memfrag reclaim hint=high
```

maria: Quick glance at metrics shows kv_cache_total ~28GB, kv_cache_free ~200MB, kv_frag_count=15 on node rwd-dc-07. Autoscaler also logged repeated scale decisions but backoff prevented new node allocation because of cooldowns. Looks like eviction churn caused per-node pressure that never stabilized.
kevin: Two likely contributors: (1) long-context workloads create lots of small KV entries which fragment the allocator; (2) prefetch/continuous caching is keeping many cold entries around and causing churn during compaction.
raj: Can you run these quick data collections on rwd-dc-07 and attach results?
```
curl -s http://rwd-dc-07:9100/metrics | grep kv_cache
curl -s http://rwd-dc-07:9100/debug/alloc_stats > /tmp/alloc_stats.json
curl -s http://rwd-dc-07:9100/debug/pprof/heap -o /tmp/heap-rwd-dc-07.pb
```

olivia: Pushed the /metrics snapshot and alloc_stats to the ticket. Customer says workload is: batch_size=8, concurrency=12, persistent prefix caching enabled, messages ~20 turns with occasional 40k token contexts.
maria: I'll spin a staging repro harness that mimics the same seq distribution and cache behavior. Plan: run at 5 qps for 20 minutes and watch eviction rate. If it reproduces, test two mitigations: tenant-level kv limit + tenant QoS (concurrent cap) and running with --kv-compact-interval=30s.
kevin: Short-term mitigation we can apply without redeploy: set tenant kv_cache_limit_mb=10240 and tenant_prefetch=false for acme. That should reduce eviction churn by bounding their footprint. Longer-term: I'm preparing a runtime patch that improves compaction heuristics for many-small-entries workloads.
raj: Also check autoscaler logs — the cooldown policy is currently blocking fast scale-ups when multiple nodes report pressure. If staging repro shows rapid per-node churn, we should tweak cooldown to prefer adding nodes earlier for dedicated pools.
olivia: Customer asked for repro steps so they can validate: we'll (1) apply tenant caps + disable prefetch, (2) run staging harness, (3) if still noisy, move tenant to isolated pool. They approved the plan.
kevin: I'll open a small PR for the compaction flag and attach a canary image; ETA ~4h.
maria: Action items: maria -> run staging repro (2h), raj -> collect full heap/profile from rwd-dc-07 and attach, kevin -> PR/canary for compaction heuristics, olivia -> communicate mitigation & timeline to customer and create support ticket.
olivia: Thanks — I'll create the ticket and schedule a 10:00 PST follow-up with ACME. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-028 assigned to eng-sre (priority P2).
